title: Front Door Paint Colors to Compare: 8 Sherwin-Williams Picks
description: One white house, one six-panel door, eight Sherwin-Williams door colors from Tricorn Black to Coral Clay, with codes, hex values, light reflectance and a note on what to check before you paint.
dek: Same door, same light, eight colors. Compare them on screen, then sample the two you like on the real door.
hook: A paint chip is small, and a front door is the first thing people see. This guide shows one white house with one six-panel door painted in eight Sherwin-Williams colors, so you can compare how each one reads against the same siding, trim and brass.

The images are AI-generated concept pictures, not photos of a real house. The code, hex value and light reflectance for each color come from Sherwin-Williams' own color pages, read Nov 14, 2026. A screen only shows a closest match, never the paint itself, so test a sample on your own door before you buy a can.
gallery_intro: Light reflectance (LRV) runs from 0 to 100, and lower numbers mean a darker color. Seven of the eight are dark, at 12 or lower. Coral Clay, at 26, is the lightest and the boldest next to white siding.
gallery_note: AI-generated concept images of one house. Colors are on-screen approximations of the paint listed under each look, so test a sample on your door. They are not photos of a real house.

tips.h: Sample on the door, not on a chip
tips.p: Paint a patch of the door itself and look at it in the morning, at midday and at dusk. Check it again at night under your porch light. A color can look different in each.
The concept images use white siding and white trim. Brick, stone, gray or tan siding changes how each color reads, so hold the sample next to your own house.
Look for an exterior label on the can, and check the color page for whether the color comes in an exterior line. Read the can for the sheen, the temperature range and the dry times.
Clean the door, lightly sand any glossy finish, and spot-prime bare wood or metal before you paint. Follow the can for how long to wait between coats.
Brass handles stand out against a dark door. Take the handleset off, or tape it well, so the paint does not end up on the metal.

tips.h: Check your door maker and your rules
tips.p: Some door materials have limits on dark colors, so check the maker's paint guidance. If you rent or live in an HOA, ask before you paint.

final: If you do one thing, sample your top two colors on the door itself and look at them at three times of day. A color that wins on a screen can lose in your own light.

how_picked: The eight colors come from Sherwin-Williams' own front door suggestions and its popular door colors, chosen to cover black, blue, green, red, warm and brown.
Codes, hex values and light reflectance were read from the Sherwin-Williams color pages on Nov 14, 2026.
The door is recolored on one image in code, so the siding, trim, light and brass stay the same in every look.
